coverage: Derived planning profiles for the bundled public New York trail segments, not curated complete hikes.
modifications: WGS84 geometry sampled at approximately 100 m (coarser on long routes), bilinear Terrarium terrain interpolation; cumulative ascent/descent derived from sampled elevations. Separate parts are not connected.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; United States 3DEP, GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
